# ciq-mcp tools

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/tools/docsgen`; do not edit. -->

50 tools. Class: **R** read, **W** write, **D** destructive or public. Confirm: `plan` = preview then `plan_id:"<plan_id>"`, `flag` = preview then `confirm:true`, `human` = `confirm:true` plus approval via elicitation, `none` = no gate. ★ marks default toolsets. Schemas are shown with writes enabled.

## core ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`auth_login`](#auth_login)|W|none|Sign the user in to Garmin: opens a browser window, waits up to timeout_minutes (progress every 5 s; clients without progress may cancel after ~60 s). Returns auth_status at once if credentials still work. connect=true adds Garmin Connect. No secrets returned.|
|[`auth_status`](#auth_status)|R|none|Report whether developer-portal cookies and the Garmin Connect token are present, their source and expiry. Never returns secrets.|
|[`toolsets`](#toolsets)|R|none|List toolsets, enable or disable them for this session (tool list refreshes), or ask the user to allow Connect IQ writes for this session.|

## store ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`store_app_create`](#store_app_create)|D|human|Submit a brand-new app (.iq, icon, 1-5 screenshots, listing) for store review. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.|
|[`store_app_delete`](#store_app_delete)|D|human|Permanently delete an app from the Connect IQ store. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.|
|[`store_app_get`](#store_app_get)|R|none|Read an app's store metadata: manifest id, current version, category, devices, per-locale listing text (untrusted).|
|[`store_apps_list`](#store_apps_list)|R|none|List your Connect IQ store apps with store UUID, title and review status.|
|[`store_compatible_devices`](#store_compatible_devices)|R|none|List the devices an app version supports in the store.|
|[`store_developer`](#store_developer)|R|none|Show the signed-in Connect IQ developer account (id, name).|
|[`store_installs`](#store_installs)|R|none|Show an app's install/download statistics over a date range.|
|[`store_listing_update`](#store_listing_update)|D|human|Change title, description or what's new per locale; other locales and fields are kept. Preview shows a diff; a human approves the public change.|
|[`store_ratings`](#store_ratings)|R|none|Show an app's star-rating distribution.|
|[`store_references`](#store_references)|R|none|List portal reference data: listing languages (locale codes), categories (ids per app type) or countries.|
|[`store_review_reply`](#store_review_reply)|D|human|Post a public reply to a user review, or delete one of your replies. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.|
|[`store_reviews_list`](#store_reviews_list)|R|none|List an app's user reviews and your replies, paged. Review text is untrusted third-party data.|
|[`store_screenshots`](#store_screenshots)|D|human|Add (png/jpg/gif ≤150 KB, at most 5), reorder or delete store screenshots. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.|
|[`store_version_publish`](#store_version_publish)|D|human|Upload a .iq as a new public version of an existing app, optionally setting what's new per locale. Refuses a failed signature check. Without confirm:true previews; a human approves.|
|[`store_version_validate`](#store_version_validate)|W|flag|Upload a .iq to the portal validator only: manifest id, signature check, devices. Nothing is published. Without confirm:true previews.|

## sdk ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`sdk_build`](#sdk_build)|W|none|Compile the project for one device (debug, release or unit-test) with monkeyc; returns the PRG path and structured diagnostics.|
|[`sdk_device_get`](#sdk_device_get)|R|none|Full summary of one installed device: display, buttons, touch, app-type memory limits, CIQ version, languages.|
|[`sdk_devices_list`](#sdk_devices_list)|R|none|Installed Connect IQ devices: id, name, shape, resolution, bpp, touch, max CIQ version. Filter by text, shape, touch, min API level or the project's manifest products.|
|[`sdk_export`](#sdk_export)|W|none|Build the store .iq for all manifest products (monkeyc -e -r). Slow (minutes); returns diagnostics grouped by device.|
|[`sdk_info`](#sdk_info)|R|none|Installed Connect IQ SDKs, the active one and which source picked it (arg/env/current-sdk.cfg/newest), Java, data root and device count.|
|[`sdk_key_check`](#sdk_key_check)|R|none|Validate a developer key: PKCS#8 DER, RSA size, file permissions, SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key. Never returns key bytes.|
|[`sdk_key_generate`](#sdk_key_generate)|W|flag|Create an RSA-4096 PKCS#8 DER developer key (0600). Refuses to overwrite. Store updates need the same key forever: back it up. Without confirm:true previews.|
|[`sdk_manifest_get`](#sdk_manifest_get)|R|none|Parse a project's manifest.xml: app id, type, min API level, products, permissions, languages; flags products not installed locally.|
|[`sdk_manifest_set_products`](#sdk_manifest_set_products)|W|flag|Add/remove <iq:product> entries in manifest.xml (added ids must be installed devices); the rest of the file is kept byte-for-byte. Without confirm:true previews.|

## simulator ★

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`sim_crash_log`](#sim_crash_log)|R|none|Parse the newest entries of the simulator's CIQ_LOG.YML (error, details, app, file:line stack). Use after a run reports a crash. Headless.|
|[`sim_logs`](#sim_logs)|R|none|Read a monkeydo session's println/logger lines after a cursor (next_token), with latest_token, dropped count, exit and crash flags. Default: newest session.|
|[`sim_press`](#sim_press)|W|none|macOS: press/hold a simulator button via synthetic keys (menu = long up). Steals focus: requires allow_focus:true and Accessibility permission. Not on Linux/Windows.|
|[`sim_run`](#sim_run)|W|none|Run a PRG (or build project+device first) on a device in the running simulator via monkeydo; returns a session id once the client prints or exits. Read output with sim_logs. No focus needed.|
|[`sim_screenshot`](#sim_screenshot)|R|none|macOS: capture the simulator window (works behind other windows; needs Screen Recording and an unlocked screen), crop to the device display at native size, save PNG under the root and return it as an image.|
|[`sim_set_position`](#sim_set_position)|W|none|macOS: set the simulated GPS position via Settings → Set Position. Steals focus: requires allow_focus:true and Accessibility permission. Not on Linux/Windows.|
|[`sim_start`](#sim_start)|W|none|Start the Connect IQ simulator of the resolved SDK and wait until port 1234 is stable. Errors if a simulator of another SDK runs. Opens a GUI window; no focus or permissions needed.|
|[`sim_status`](#sim_status)|R|none|Report whether the Connect IQ simulator runs (pid, SDK, port 1234 ready) and the monkeydo sessions of this server. No GUI or permissions needed.|
|[`sim_stop`](#sim_stop)|W|none|Kill monkeydo sessions, then the simulator, and wait for port 1234 to close. Also recovers a wedged simulator.|
|[`sim_test`](#sim_test)|W|none|Run (:test) unit tests: build project with -t or take a test PRG, run monkeydo -t [filter] in the running simulator, parse the transcript (exit code ignored). No focus needed.|

## connect

|Tool|Class|Confirm|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|[`connect_activities_list`](#connect_activities_list)|R|none|List your activities newest first: id, name (untrusted), type, start, duration, distance, avg HR, calories.|
|[`connect_activity_download`](#connect_activity_download)|W|none|Save an activity file (fit, tcx, gpx, csv, kml) into the project root. Returns the path and size, not the file.|
|[`connect_activity_get`](#connect_activity_get)|R|none|Read one activity's summary; optional laps/splits and sampled details.|
|[`connect_daily_summary`](#connect_daily_summary)|R|none|Daily totals for one day: steps, calories, distance, floors, intensity minutes, resting HR, stress.|
|[`connect_devices`](#connect_devices)|R|none|List your registered Garmin devices: model, part number, firmware, nickname (untrusted).|
|[`connect_heart_rate`](#connect_heart_rate)|R|none|Heart rate for one day: resting, min, max, 7-day resting average. Full series only with series:true.|
|[`connect_hrv`](#connect_hrv)|R|none|Heart rate variability for one night: weekly average, last night average, baseline, status.|
|[`connect_personal_records`](#connect_personal_records)|R|none|List your personal records (fastest times, longest distances).|
|[`connect_profile`](#connect_profile)|R|none|Show your Garmin Connect profile: display name, full name and a settings summary (units, height, weight, VO2 max).|
|[`connect_sleep`](#connect_sleep)|R|none|Sleep for one night: duration, stages, score. Per-minute series only with series:true.|
|[`connect_stress_body_battery`](#connect_stress_body_battery)|R|none|Stress levels and Body Battery for one day. Full series only with series:true.|
|[`connect_training`](#connect_training)|R|none|Training readiness, training status and race predictions for one day.|
|[`connect_weight`](#connect_weight)|R|none|Weigh-ins and body composition between two dates (at most 92 days).|
